heard: 4,000 ships sailed to conquer Japan. Regent Hojo Tokimune ordered the beheading of Mongol envoys. A 20-kilometer stone wall blocked the invaders from landing. For seven weeks, samurai boats harassed the stalled fleet. Desperate Mongols lashed their ships together with heavy chains. On August 15, a monster typhoon smashed the trapped armada. Over 100,000 men drowned when the chained ship shattered. 4,000 ships sailed to conquer Japan before the storm struck.
